look: Sathya's AI for Real Life collage reel series: white paper-texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spot / soft / dark light; full-colour pop-art sticker cut-outs pinned with heavy soft drop shadows; brand accents pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD only, blue for what passes and pink for what is wrong; pro camera rig travelling a tall world with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins and whip cuts; Morven kicker over huge Allenoire headlines with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes, stamps, rows and nodes, hand-drawn pink strokes; a ghost outline word behind every scene; AI for Real Life logo end card. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, cut to the 27 Nov 2026 silent-failure script's timecodes, no voice-over, SFX-only score, text inside the Reels safe zone. rich

scenes.name: 100 ran, 31 right
scenes.desc: Frame 0 is the hook: a full blue bar reading 100% over a short pink bar stopped at 31%, both from one benchmark run; a gauge ticks beside them and a stamp slams IT RAN. IT'S WRONG.

scenes.name: They just run it
scenes.desc: A terminal types its way to status OPTIMAL and finished - 0 errors in blue while a hand works the mouse; IT SHIPS is stamped underneath.

scenes.name: Not a crash
scenes.desc: A paper drops in under a lower third dated 24 Nov 2026 and a loupe; the headline turns over from NOT A CRASH to A CLEAN ANSWER TO THE WRONG QUESTION.

scenes.name: It cannot see
scenes.desc: Split screen: the constraints on a clipboard land in blue on the left, the real warehouse rows land in pink on the right; the camera tilts down to an eye with a pink stroke drawn through it.

scenes.name: Still valid
scenes.desc: Four rules land in a list, the shift limit greys out and is crumpled away, then the camera tilts down as a hand stamps OPTIMAL and a confident total counts up to 41,920.

scenes.name: Half a percent to 31
scenes.desc: A pink bar climbs from 0.5% to 31% beside a ladder, with the population and tolerance noted on tags underneath.

scenes.name: The rest is silent
scenes.desc: The repaired 31% holds while a hatched pink block floods the remaining 69% of the bar and the number counts up under the word SILENT.

scenes.name: Change one input
scenes.desc: Three input cells land, a hand pushes the unit cost from 12.00 to 14.40 and it turns pink, the answer barely moves from 41,920 to 41,930, and a red flag drops and swings to rest.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
